description: OFF-BALL RUN VARIETY 5 - A SECOND DIAGONAL RUN AT NORMAL ATTACK LEVELS. DEPENDS ON offball-run-variety.json BEING APPLIED; on its own it does nothing. ActionSelectorDiagonalRun is action id 0x21. Its quota case in 0x1442f9a90 (block at 0x1442f9c3c) builds {1,1,1,2,2} indexed by the team attack level [teamCtx+0xb450] clamped to 4; its maxSlots byte (own ctor 0x143e02781, sel+0xe4) is 1 in stock and was already raised to 2 by offball-run-variety.json. The dispatcher takes the min of the two caps (quota check at 0x143df1651, maxSlots check at 0x143df165b), so with maxSlots 2 the quota {1,1,1,...} is now the binding cap at the three lower attack levels and the second diagonal runner still never appears except in all-out attack. This patch makes it {1,2,2,2,2}. Level 0 is deliberately left at 1: at the lowest attack level one runner is right. The top value stays 2 because maxSlots is 2 - going to 3 here would be dead bytes. WHY A SECOND ONE MATTERS: DiagonalRun's scorer vf5 (0x143e036e0) returns xmm9, written exactly once, at 0x143e03a0d, as ([teamRecord + 5*opp*4 + 0x44] - player.x) * attackDir = HOW DEEP THE PLAYER IS BEHIND THE OPPONENT DEFENSIVE LINE. The dispatcher sorts descending (sort 0x143b45ce0 with comparator 0x143df1060 on record+4) and takes the top N, so with N=1 the deepest eligible man wins every single evaluation and nobody else ever makes a diagonal run - which is exactly the 'runs are one-dimensional' complaint. With N=2 the second-deepest goes too, from a different angle. Unlike SecondLineSpaceRun there is no same-type bail in this selector's mask: I scanned vf4 (0x143e04050) and vf5 for a compare of the slot action table against 0x21, and the only hit, 0x143e038ac, is a register compare inside the continuing-run branch, not a whole-mask bail. So the quota really is the cap. NO RNG: the same global call-graph search described in offball-quota-chance.json (943,597 direct call edges, RNG set = every function holding the LCG multiplier 0x2d22b2e3 plus every direct caller, searched 6 levels) found no path from vf4 (320 functions) or vf5 (200 functions) to any randomiser, while two controls in the same run did hit one. Indirect and virtual calls are not followed. TICK AND COMMITMENT: the manager 0x143d52470 runs once per frame per team, alternating by frame parity, and a diagonal run in progress is only cancellable after a minimum of int(fps*0.2+0.5) frames (0x143e051b2 mulss with the 0.2f cell, compared at 0x143e051c7 against elapsed = [rec+8]-[rec+4] of the per-slot action record at teamAI+0x8f78+slot*0x34). So the run holds for at least 0.2 s and is then re-tested every frame. RISK: two diagonal runners can converge, because vf6 places each target without knowing about the other. Watch the offside line: offball-diagonal-behind.json already pushes each target 3 m deeper, so if both are applied expect flags. Revert this one first if the runners bunch. WHO: everyone. 0x143d03493 is the ONLY reference to the manager update in the image (every E8/E9 rel32 was byte-scanned), and there is no human/CPU test on the path, so the human's AI team-mates and the CPU are affected identically. EVIDENCE: (b) disassembly for the quota case, both caps, the score's single write, the commitment timer and the absence of a same-type bail; (a) emulation only for the RNG search; (c) inferred that the attack-level index reads as build-up through all-out attack. BYTES: byte-identical in the PRISTINE backup and the installed exe; an inline immediate of the same length; no pool cell touched. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/offball-quota-diagonal.json
